title: Meaning heard anew changes the argument

captions.physics: Speaking of possibly returning to conversation
captions.emotions: Feeling a changed impression of words

meaning: You can speak of possibly returning to conversation and respond to meaning understood anew, noticing changed impressions without treating every new feeling as a new fact.
text: On your Vishuddha, the Star in the physical position appears in talking about possibly returning to an exchange. Judgement in energy supports readiness to respond to meaning understood anew and answer a familiar remark differently. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions brings a changed impression of what was heard. You can hope for a clearer exchange and notice earlier words now prompt another response. A changed experience does not cancel the substance genuinely clarified.

Suppose there is hope of returning later to “I am not arguing”. Discussion reveals that it meant willingness to listen rather than agreement with a conclusion. **New meaning can change how an earlier conversation feels**. Relief appears first, then surprise that positions remain different. You can hear the present attitude directly without restoring the remark’s former meaning for convenience. Open continuation allows several impressions rather than immediately requiring one final feeling assigned to both.

Difficulty arises if every change of mood triggers reconsideration of already clear meaning. Yesterday’s relief and today’s frustration supposedly prove different intentions. Constructive Judgement helps respond to something genuinely newly heard while distinguishing a changed experience. You can feel differently about one exchange and preserve an understood limit to agreement; hope for further conversation requires neither beginning a phrase’s meaning from zero each time nor declaring an earlier explanation unreliable.
